access-check.name: Access Check
access-check.tagline: Name any website, get a plain read of basic accessibility signals on its home page: language, alt text, labels, zoom.

air-quality.name: Air Quality Check
air-quality.tagline: Type a city anywhere, see its air quality right now and the current particle levels, from open forecast data.

checks.fix: Redirect http to https and serve a valid certificate.
checks.title: Serves over HTTPS

checks.fix: Publish a security.txt with a Contact line so researchers can report a flaw privately.
checks.title: Publishes /.well-known/security.txt (RFC 9116)

checks.fix: Add a TXT record starting v=spf1 that lists who may send mail for the domain.
checks.title: Has an SPF record

checks.fix: Add a TXT record at _dmarc with at least v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:you@yourdomain.
checks.title: Has a DMARC record

checks.fix: Say what you keep and link it in the footer.
checks.title: Links a privacy notice from the home page

checks.fix: Publish terms and link them in the footer.
checks.title: Links terms of use from the home page

checks.fix: Publish an accessibility statement and link it in the footer.
checks.title: Links an accessibility statement from the home page

blindspot.name: Blindspot Check
blindspot.tagline: What does your website not tell people? Type a domain, see the gaps in a minute.

country-snapshot.name: Country Snapshot
country-snapshot.tagline: Type a country code, see its latest World Bank figures for electricity, drinking water, internet use and literacy.

free-tier-meter.name: Free-Tier Meter
free-tier-meter.tagline: How much of Cloudflare's free plan does a whole autonomous system use today? Live, from the loop that spends it.

loop-ledger.name: Loop Ledger
loop-ledger.tagline: How many closed loops keep this system running, and which ones are on a clock.

numbers-board.name: Ultrastable by the Numbers
numbers-board.tagline: Loops running, edges wired, stories passing and what the system does not know yet, straight from its own ledger.

portfolio-board.name: Spinoff Portfolio
portfolio-board.tagline: The apps Ultrastable launched on its own, what they cost and how many it retired.

caps.note: free tier only: Cloudflare Workers free requests, one shared D1, no paid model calls; the ceiling is zero. The daily launch count is set by the free-tier governor level (doctrine/spinoff-ideas.json cadence), so the loop fills headroom and never spends past it.
